components.name: Primary action
components.description: Implemented primary action; theme variables inherit from the host.
components.css: .ds-primary{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:9px 14px;min-height:36px;border:1px solid var(--line,#dce2e9);border-radius:7px;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .14s ease-out;font-family:"Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;background:var(--action,#245bdd);border-color:transparent;color:var(--action-text,#fff)}.ds-primary:hover{filter:brightness(.95)}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--action,#245bdd);outline-offset:3px}.ds-primary:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-primary:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{transition:none}}

components.name: Secondary action

components.name: Text field
components.description: Dictionary field with label, caret and focus treatment.
components.html: <label class="ds-label">Spoken phrase or name<input class="ds-input" placeholder="cloud code"></label>
components.css: .ds-label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;font-size:12px;color:var(--text,#1d2533);font-family:"Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;}.ds-input{font:inherit;border:1px solid var(--line,#dce2e9);border-radius:7px;padding:9px 11px;background:var(--panel,#fff);color:var(--text,#1d2533);caret-color:var(--action,#245bdd);min-width:0}.ds-input::placeholder{color:var(--muted,#596577)}.ds-input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--action,#245bdd);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Current navigation
components.description: Selection is shown only when the destination is visible, never during setup.
components.html: <nav aria-label="Main navigation"><button class="ds-nav" aria-current="page"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="3" y="3" width="7" height="9" rx="1"/><rect x="14" y="3" width="7" height="5" rx="1"/><rect x="14" y="12" width="7" height="9" rx="1"/><rect x="3" y="16" width="7" height="5" rx="1"/></svg>Dictation</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-nav{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:9px 14px;min-height:36px;border:1px solid var(--line,#dce2e9);border-radius:7px;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .14s ease-out;font-family:"Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;justify-content:flex-start;border:0;padding:11px 13px;gap:12px;background:var(--selected,#e0eafd);color:var(--text,#1d2533)}.ds-nav svg{color:var(--action,#245bdd);flex-shrink:0}.ds-nav:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--action,#245bdd);outline-offset:3px}.ds-nav:active{transform:translateY(1px)}

components.name: Recording mode segments

components.css: .ds-segments{font-family:"Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;display:inline-flex;padding:3px;background:var(--raised,#f1f4f8);border-radius:8px}.ds-segment{position:relative;cursor:pointer}.ds-segment input{position:absolute;opacity:0;width:1px;height:1px}.ds-segment span{display:block;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;padding:7px 12px;border-radius:6px;color:var(--muted,#596577)}.ds-segment input:checked+span{background:var(--panel,#fff);color:var(--text,#1d2533);box-shadow:0 1px 3px #00000016}.ds-segment input:focus-visible+span{outline:2px solid var(--action,#245bdd);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Shortcut capture state
components.description: Visual capture preview; keyboard/native capture behavior belongs to main.ts, not this static snippet.
components.html: <button class="ds-capture" aria-label="Change recording shortcut"><kbd>Press a key or mouse button…</kbd></button>
components.css: .ds-capture{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:9px 14px;min-height:36px;border:1px solid var(--line,#dce2e9);border-radius:7px;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .14s ease-out;font-family:"Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;min-width:180px;justify-content:space-between;border:2px solid var(--action,#245bdd);background:var(--selected,#e0eafd);color:var(--text,#1d2533);padding:8px 13px}.ds-capture kbd{font:inherit;white-space:nowrap}.ds-capture:hover{background:var(--raised,#f1f4f8)}.ds-capture:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--action,#245bdd);outline-offset:3px}.ds-capture:active{transform:translateY(1px)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-capture{transition:none}}

narrative.overview: Dictate’s Windows renderer is a compact dictation utility with Segoe typography, slate surfaces, blue actions and familiar grouped controls. One recording action anchors Dictation; task-specific rows and forms give History, Dictionary, Statistics, Speech models and Settings their own useful density. This documents the implemented Desktop renderer, replacing the previous warm/serif specification.
keyCharacteristics: Persistent desktop navigation with honest current-page state.
Compact sans typography, fine borders and continuous model rows.
Explicit local-processing states, preserved drafts and recoverable words.
dos: Do preserve Segoe typography, slate surfaces, blue actions and compact grouped controls.
Do reflect saved recording mode and insertion preferences in guidance, and preserve drafts, focus and text selection.
Do check light, dark and minimum-window states using clearly labeled evidence.
donts: Don't reintroduce oversized serif headings, warm/violet styling or Mac-specific shortcut labels into this Windows renderer.
Don't describe synthetic browser evidence as native Windows, Segoe, microphone, physical-input, inference or installer validation.
Don't change the existing Dictate icon identity or add decorative shipping raster assets for this interface.
